summary: An elven longbow of high-fantasy style, 1.72 m tip to tip (real longbows run 1.7-1.9 m), braced: pale ash lim… joints limb_upper, string_upper, limb_lower, string_lower; sockets socket_arrow, nocking_point, grip_l, sight, muzzle.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.bow_longbow_elven or place "prefab": "bow_longbow_elven" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d(), viewmodel().
